ensemble.name: ensemble
ensemble.rule: Arithmetic mean of the three legal-action logits; common heuristic prior is preserved. Greedy argmax. No fitting, calibrated probabilities or confirmation-tuned weights. Values averaged for API compatibility only, not calibrated ensemble win probability.

replays.selection: Two games per policy, all five counts and four variant/auction pairs; lexicographically minimum canonical-task SHA256 within each predefined slot, never by outcomes.
replays.note: Timing deliberately excluded from equality. Replays verify compact terminal evidence, not a saved action trace; no new deals or training data.

uncertainty.primaryEstimand: Equal-weight macro credit over 20 fixed Germany cells; average all focal seats within each deal first.
uncertainty.independentUnit: 80 paired independent deals, four per cell; 1920 seat/policy repeats are not independent trials.
uncertainty.formula: For H cells, paired difference = mean_h mean_d (seatMean(policy)-seatMean(control)); SE = sqrt(sum_h s_h^2/4)/H, sample variance uses ddof=1.
uncertainty.interval: Approximate normal point +/-1.96*unbiased stratified paired SE, no clipping, no bootstrap.
caveats: Four clusters/cell is small; approximate normal intervals can be unreliable for individual cells.
All six policies and both contrasts reported. No correction for multiple policy/subgroup comparisons; exploratory, not qualification.
Reference control equals 1/n exactly after all-seat averaging; zero reference SE is a design identity, not certainty about general playing strength.
Fixed policies/reference population and Germany only; no inference to humans, other maps or production.
Original summary used unstratified paired-deal SE. Its numeric values were independently reproduced, but new intervals use fixed-cell stratification.
No action traces were saved; legality is enforced by the unchanged authoritative bridge and checked on the replay subset, not independently reconstructed for every recorded move.

conclusion: All four frozen candidates and the teacher trail the all-reference baseline on the primary macro-cell estimate; all five unadjusted approximate-normal 95% paired intervals versus reference lie below zero. No candidate-versus-teacher approximate interval excludes zero. These are exploratory comparisons, not multiplicity-adjusted significance or qualification. Report every candidate without best-seed selection or promotion.
